mentions.name: Browser-based offline fungi vision detection
mentions.description: This app performs fungi vision detection entirely in the browser, working offline. Its CNN model is trained to detect a few thousand fungi species accurately in near real time, and development continues toward covering far more species and exploring other CNN architectures.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Fungi vision detection on the browser. Offline

https://fungi.renderlab.cc

Trained to detect a few thousands species pretty accurately in near real time.
